source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    candidates = [(counts[grid[0][c]], 'col', c) for c in range(1, w - 1)
                  if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)]
    candidates += [(counts[row[0]], 'row', r) for r, row in enumerate(grid[1:-1], 1)
                   if all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    _, axis, cut = min(candidates)
    if axis == 'col':
        first = [row[:cut] for row in grid]
        second = [row[cut + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        first = grid[:cut]
        second = grid[cut + 1:]
    background = Counter(v for row in first for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else background
             for c in range(len(first[0]))] for r in range(len(first))]
'''
